meetings.summary: The committee tabled the October 15 joint-meeting minutes and a bylaw change on membership because of notice and open meeting law problems. It voted to pay the camera operator for cancelled-game time and accepted an evaluation form for the administrator. How to classify a student hire was left for the town manager.

what_happened.line: The committee tabled the October 15 joint-meeting minutes to its next meeting; the vote is recorded as passed.
A bylaw change on membership was tabled, and a member will submit suggested bylaw language for the next meeting.
The committee set December 9 at 7:00 to ratify five August votes, after the selectman liaison said the agenda was not specific enough.
A motion to pay the videographer for time on cancelled games was made; the minutes do not record an audible result.
An evaluation instrument for the administrator position was accepted, to be reviewed in February with the process starting in March.

why_it_matters: Notice and open meeting law problems put five August spending votes, including desktop computers, back up for re-ratification, so the committee's purchases from public cable funds may rest on a December vote.
How the student hire is classified, as vendor or employee, is unresolved and was left for the town manager, which affects how the position is paid and overseen.
watch_next: December 9 at 7:00: the committee is to ratify the five August votes and discuss hiring the student.
The next meeting: the tabled October 15 minutes and the membership bylaw language are due back.
